title: the acid room flips at the change, then the camera swings every two bars
story: Cerrone at 123 bpm, a disco four on the floor: every kick lifts the room and every clap throws the sweep and flattens the lamp, open hats tick the brightness. The synth loop is a small dolly that restarts each bar. At 2378 the change swings the palette (hue -0.12, contrast open), the camera drops to a low angle and then cuts every two bars, mirrored, with the hue turning back and forth.
